props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

props.name: alt
props.description: Accessible text alternative for the image.

props.name: checked
props.description: Current checked state when controlled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents user interaction.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum allowed value.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Maximum number of input characters.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum allowed value.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allows more than one value to be selected.

props.name: name
props.description: Field name used in form data.

props.name: placeholder

props.name: required

props.name: src

props.name: step

props.name: type

props.name: value
